fact: Countdown to 2030's synthesis with ministry staff states that the overall DHIS2 facility data-quality score fell from 71 per cent in 2019 to 63 per cent in 2024 and that the share of districts with report completeness of 90 per cent or more stood at 57 per cent in 2024 for antenatal care and delivery (the text calls this a fall from 31 per cent in 2019, which is inconsistent), attributing the decline to strikes in health facilities between 2022 and 2024 that disrupted transmission of data into DHIS2; the figure is of districts, not clinics.
title: Rapport d'analyse : Analyse des indicateurs de santé reproductive, maternelle, néonatale, infantile et adolescente pour 2019-2024 : Document de synthèse
